name: A Series of Icky Interviews
source:
Ryan King, down-on-his-luck journalist, gets a letter inviting him to a secretive, high-paying government job. Only problem: it’s addressed to a Dr. King. But since interviews are your forte, a little harmless impersonation might pay off.

[From [url=https://emzilla8.itch.io/a-series-of-icky-interviews]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
瑞恩·金（Ryan King）是一位运气不佳的记者，他收到一封邀请信，邀请他担任一份秘密的高薪政府工作。唯一的问题是：它是写给金博士的。但由于采访是你的强项，一点无害的模仿可能会有回报。

[来自[url=https://emzilla8.itch.io/a-series-of-icky-interviews]Itch.io[/url]]
